purpose: Optional frontier profile for complex professional reasoning and coding work.

constraints: Use representative evals before changing a workload role.
Keep tool permissions, step limits, approvals, and post-action verification explicit.

budgets.tokens: Set per workload and test long-context multipliers.
budgets.latency: Compare the selected reasoning effort on representative tasks.
budgets.retries: Bound and do not repeat without new evidence.
budgets.cost: Check current official pricing and expected, burst, and worst-case volume before paid execution.

fallback.behavior: Use the project's approved model profile or report an unavailable capability; do not silently change quality, cost, or authority.
